mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.path, m.component, m.perms, m.order_num, m.visible, m.icon FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status = '0' WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num, m.menu_id
